integrity: The all-parameter claim is established by a self-contained missing-edge double count; the code provides finite corroboration only. Historical priority is qualified by unindexed literature risk. No independent mathematical validation has occurred.
scientific_limitations: Only finite simple bipartite graphs with each cross-edge deletion degree at most \(d\) and both shore sizes at least \(2d+3\), for integers \(d\ge1\); the optimality example concerns the symmetric boundary. No unconditional claim for smaller shores.
title: Sharp \(P_3\)-convex-set stability under locally bounded bipartite edge deletion
